text: 中国财政部发行63天期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率1.0495%，边际利率1.1378%，预期1.1400%，投标倍数3.56倍，边际倍数8.82倍； 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模350亿元，发行利率1.1270%，边际利率1.1787%，预期1.2000%，投标倍数3.42倍，边际倍数3.33倍； 中国财政部发行50年期债券，规模350亿元，发行利率2.2778%，预期2.2800%，投标倍数10.07倍，边际倍数1.04倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 63-day bonds, size 20 billion yuan, issuance rate 1.0495%, marginal rate 1.1378%, expected 1.1400%, bid-to-cover ratio 3.56x, marginal coverage 8.82x; China's Ministry of Finance issued 91-day bonds, size 35 billion yuan, issuance rate 1.1270%, marginal rate 1.1787%, expected 1.2000%, bid-to-cover ratio 3.42x, marginal coverage 3.33x; China's Ministry of Finance issued 50-year bonds, size 35 billion yuan, issuance rate 2.2778%, expected 2.2800%, bid-to-cover ratio 10.07x, marginal coverage 1.04x.
